Class Journal

java.lang.Object
lms.domain.Journal
All Implemented Interfaces:
LoanableItem
public class Journal extends Object implements LoanableItem
Represents a journal in the library collection.

Contains metadata including title, author, and copy availability.

Version:
2.0
Author:
Ahmad Salameh
